name: Fort St. James Nickel Corp.
summary: Fort St. James Nickel Corp. operates as an emerging mineral exploration enterprise dedicated to identifying, assessing, and developing resource properties throughout North America. Its primary focus lies in the discovery of nickel deposits. The company holds outright ownership of the Kilometer 26 property, an area covering 5,778 hectares located in British Columbia's Omineca Mining Division. Additionally, it has secured an option to purchase the Porcupine property, situated in New Brunswick, and has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire full control of the Nepisiguit Property, also found in New Brunswick. Established in 1988, the firm's principal office is located in Vancouver, Canada.
